name: Counter Maneuver (Combat)
body:
You use your opponent’s failed maneuvers as a window of opportunity to make your own.

Prerequisite: Combat Expertise

Benefit: Whenever an opponent makes a failed combat maneuver check against you, you can use an attack of opportunity to attempt the same kind of maneuver upon that opponent. You must be able to reach your opponent to do so.
